## 📊 Monthly Crime Count, Temperature & Precipitation

```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# 聚合数据
monthly = df_interactive.groupby('month').agg({
    'crime_code_description': 'count',
    'daily_avg_temperature_celsius': 'mean',
    'daily_precipitation_mm': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

# 绘图
fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=monthly['month'], y=monthly['crime_code_description'], name='Crime Count'))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=monthly['month'], y=monthly['daily_avg_temperature_celsius'], name='Avg Temp (°C)', mode='lines+markers'))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=monthly['month'], y=monthly['daily_precipitation_mm'], name='Avg Precipitation (mm)', mode='lines+markers'))

fig.update_layout(
    title='Monthly Crime Count, Avg Temperature, and Precipitation',
    xaxis_title='Month',
    yaxis_title='Crime Count',
    template='plotly_white'
)

# 关键行 ✅ 保存为独立 HTML 图表
fig.write_html("docs/crime_temp_precip_chart.html")
```
